newsitem.title: FRANCE: French employers see two pct GDP growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: French employers see two pct GDP growth in 1997.

text.p: France's employers' confederation, the CNPF, said on Wednesday it expected economic growth of around two percent next year.
The organisation said this was the "most likely" outcome, echoing estimates by various forecasting institutes which have painted growth either side of two percent.
The French government has assumed growth of 2.3 percent in its 1997 budget.
In a regular report on the economy, the CNPF's economic affairs commission said the current slow economic recovery masked significant differences between individual sectors.
